config.purpose: 4P4M8C independent local mixtures, fixed-opening hit timing, limited mafia ballot disguise, anti-bait cover, and train-only incremental response-pool expansion

expansion.rule: At most one train best response per side per round; no heldout outcomes may change membership or weights.

config.interpretation: All main results are 4P4M8C. Local mixtures are independent actor draws or public-position rules without a secret faction plan. Matrix expansion is finite-candidate response coverage, not CFR convergence or complete-game GTO. Timing effects are paired within selected first-night states; the civilian-aligned cohort is narrower by design.

intervals: Pointwise exploratory 95%; no multiplicity correction. Paired Wald plus conservative Hoeffding.
outcome: good faction terminal win, 0/1; no rollout truncation
